name: Juanita Delgado
description: A 33-year-old single woman with borderline personality disorder and major depression, struggling with identity issues, self-harm behaviors, and chronic social isolation.

demographic_sociocultural_information.cultural_background: Hispanic woman raised in an upper-middle-class immigrant family that emphasized professional achievement.
demographic_sociocultural_information.spoken_language: Not reported; therapy conducted in English.
demographic_sociocultural_information.migration_status: Second-generation immigrant background; born and raised locally with immigrant parents.

family_social_history.developmental_family_dynamics: Middle of three siblings in a high-achieving household where her father prioritized success, fostering chronic feelings of isolation and anger.
family_social_history.current_parent_relationships: Ambivalent view of her father, describing him as both a spectacular success and a manipulative loser; no details provided about her mother.
family_social_history.childhood_experiences: Felt isolated throughout school, experienced recurrent depressed mood, and was known for angry outbursts.

family_social_context.social_support_overview: Limited in-person support; has been socially isolated for months with minimal engagement.
family_social_context.support_network: Maintains superficial contact with former college peers through social media; views most neighborhood friends negatively.

education_and_employment.education_level: Completed high school with strong academics; withdrew from college after conflicts with a roommate and a professor.
education_and_employment.employment_history: Multiple internships and entry-level positions ended abruptly due to perceived disrespect from supervisors; currently unemployed.
education_and_employment.housing_stability: Lives alone in her apartment; housing appears stable but isolating.
education_and_employment.financial_situation: Financially strained by unemployment and excessive online shopping beyond her means.
education_and_employment.hobbies_interests: Passively watches television and shops online; no sustaining hobbies reported.

psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.current_and_past_psychiatric_diagnoses: Borderline personality disorder and major depressive disorder; persistent depressive disorder to be ruled in if symptoms persist beyond two years.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.main_symptoms: Depressed mood, anergia, overeating, chronic suicidal ideation, poor hygiene, episodic 1-2 day energized periods followed by crashes, anger dysregulation, and social withdrawal.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.emotional_reactions_and_mood: Generally dysphoric with constricted affect, alternating shame and reactive anger, and brief energized episodes.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.auto_hetero_directed_aggression: Engages in superficial cutting, has attempted overdoses, and externalizes anger toward perceived slights from others.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.self_perception_and_identity: Sees herself as both inadequate and destined for greatness, reflecting identity diffusion and unstable self-image.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.psychiatric_comorbidities: Co-occurring depressive symptoms; bipolar disorder considered but criteria not met.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.self_esteem: Chronically low self-esteem punctuated by grandiose self-beliefs.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.sense_of_self_and_others: Splitting and projection shape views of self and others as either exceptional or malicious.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.identity_disturbances: Pronounced identity diffusion consistent with borderline personality organization.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.cognitive_style: Rigid, accusatory thinking with externalization of blame toward authority figures.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.cognitive_schemas: Dominated by mistrust, expectations of betrayal, and fear of failure.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.attachment_style: Fearful-avoidant; avoids intimacy due to anxiety and distrust.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.executive_functioning: Capable of coherent planning in session but struggles to sustain effort and follow-through in work and daily structure during mood episodes.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.attention_and_concentration: Not formally assessed; likely fluctuates with mood and sleep disruption.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.sensory_perception: Reality testing generally intact; no hallucinations reported.
psychological_profile_and_cognitive_func.higher_cognitive_functions: Thought processes remain coherent and goal directed despite affective volatility.

coping_mechanisms_and_defenses.coping_strategies: Relies on withdrawal, extended bed rest, passive media consumption, and compulsive online shopping; lacks adaptive coping tools.
coping_mechanisms_and_defenses.defense_mechanisms: Splitting, projection, devaluation of others, and idealization of her own potential.

dysfunctional_behaviors_and_risk.self_harm_and_suicidality: Superficial self-cutting, persistent thoughts of death, and three hospitalizations following overdoses.
dysfunctional_behaviors_and_risk.avoidance_behaviors: Avoids social contact, intimacy, and sustained employment; spends extended periods isolated at home.
dysfunctional_behaviors_and_risk.impulsive_and_risky_behaviors: Compulsive spending, abrupt job resignations, and explosive anger reactions to perceived slights.
dysfunctional_behaviors_and_risk.morality: Rigid moral judgments with strong resentment toward perceived manipulation; no antisocial conduct noted.

social_relationships_and_interactions.friendships: Few active friendships; maintains distant online connections with former classmates while dismissing local peers.
social_relationships_and_interactions.romantic_relationships: Past dating limited by anxiety around physical closeness; currently not in a romantic relationship.
social_relationships_and_interactions.sexual_relationships: Avoids sexual intimacy due to heightened anxiety and mistrust.
social_relationships_and_interactions.family_interactions: History of angry outbursts within family and lasting resentment toward her father.
social_relationships_and_interactions.peer_and_colleague_relationships: Pattern of conflict with supervisors and colleagues whom she perceives as disrespectful or manipulative.
social_relationships_and_interactions.social_media_behavior: Uses social media to stay connected superficially and to idealize the successes of distant acquaintances.

treatments_and_interventions.previous_therapeutic_experiences: Multiple psychotherapy attempts with minimal perceived benefit.
treatments_and_interventions.treatment_progress_and_resistance: Chronic treatment resistance marked by mistrust, anger at providers, and limited insight into interpersonal patterns.
treatments_and_interventions.therapeutic_goals: Stabilize mood, reduce self-harm risk, rebuild daily functioning, and develop sustainable social connections.
treatments_and_interventions.pharmacological_history: Trials of mood stabilizers, antidepressants, and low-dose antipsychotics with limited effectiveness.
treatments_and_interventions.medication_response: Reports little relief from prescribed medications and frequently discontinues due to perceived ineffectiveness.
treatments_and_interventions.hospitalization_history: Psychiatrically hospitalized three times following intentional overdoses.
treatments_and_interventions.hospitalization_details: Inpatient admissions for stabilization after overdoses; specific facilities and durations not provided.
treatments_and_interventions.emergency_room_visits: Emergency care sought during overdose episodes; frequency beyond hospitalizations not documented.
treatments_and_interventions.historical_psychiatric_diagnoses: Diagnosed with borderline personality disorder and major depressive disorder; bipolar spectrum ruled out.

clinical_judgment_and_decision_capacitie.judgment_capacity: Judgment fluctuates; generally intact but compromised when she perceives disrespect or abandonment.
clinical_judgment_and_decision_capacitie.insight_awareness: Aware of depressive symptoms yet minimizes her role in interpersonal conflicts and projects blame outward.
clinical_judgment_and_decision_capacitie.impulse_control: Notably poor during affective surges, leading to self-harm and abrupt decisions.
clinical_judgment_and_decision_capacitie.self_control: Limited under stress though can remain cooperative and coherent during structured interviews.

resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.psychological_resilience: Low resilience with prolonged periods of withdrawal and difficulty recovering from setbacks.
resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.self_compassion: Very limited; oscillates between self-loathing and grandiose self-expectations.
resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.life_satisfaction: Reports pervasive dissatisfaction with life and achievements.
resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.personal_growth: Stagnant personal development despite aspirations for greatness.
resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.sense_of_coherence: Fragmented narrative with inconsistent integration of self and others.
resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.sense_of_control_or_empowerment: Feels powerless when dependent on others and attempts to regain control by quitting roles and relationships.
resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.hope_for_future: Ambivalent; combines despair with fantasies of future accomplishments.
resilience_and_psychological_wellbeing.long_term_life_goals: Dreams of doing something great but lacks concrete plans or steps.

medical_and_physical_history.pharmacological_treatments: Currently prescribed mood stabilizers, antidepressants, and low-dose antipsychotics, though adherence is unclear.
medical_and_physical_history.lifestyle: Sedentary, spends much of the day in bed, with poor personal hygiene and limited daily structure.
medical_and_physical_history.general_physical_health: No major illnesses noted but physical self-care is compromised.
medical_and_physical_history.sleep_patterns: Irregular sleep with all-nighters during brief energized periods followed by 12-hour crashes and extended daytime bedrest.
medical_and_physical_history.eating_habits: Heavy reliance on junk food and overeating, especially during depressive episodes.

social_and_environmental_context.community_social_support: Minimal involvement with community resources or support systems.
social_and_environmental_context.housing_conditions: Lives alone in an apartment that serves as both refuge and site of prolonged isolation.
social_and_environmental_context.social_security: Unemployed with unclear access to financial assistance or benefits.
social_and_environmental_context.social_cohesion: Feels disconnected from neighbors and broader community.
social_and_environmental_context.social_determinants_of_mental_health: Chronic unemployment, financial strain, social isolation, and familial achievement pressure exacerbate symptoms.

test_session_behavior.recurring_dynamics: Displays sensitivity to perceived slights, reacting with anger when the clinician glanced at the clock, consistent with borderline transference patterns.
test_session_behavior.prevalent_emotions: Dysphoria, shame, irritability, and guarded hopefulness surfaced during the session.
test_session_behavior.speech_characteristics: Coherent, goal-directed speech with edgy tone when discussing grievances.
test_session_behavior.nonverbal_communication: Casually groomed yet somewhat unkempt appearance; cooperative demeanor despite evident tension.

background: A 33-year-old Hispanic woman with a complex psychological profile presenting with borderline personality disorder and major depressive disorder. She has a history of multiple treatment attempts, self-harm behaviors, and social isolation. Her background includes an upper-middle-class immigrant family that emphasized professional achievement, contributing to her current struggles with identity, relationships, and career stability.
objectives: ["Stabilize mood and reduce depressive symptoms", "Develop healthy coping mechanisms", "Improve interpersonal relationships and social functioning", "Address self-harm behaviors and suicidal ideation", "Build sustainable daily routines and work habits", "Enhance self-awareness and emotional regulation"]
